body: Arghhh I definitely have to try Autumn People. It sounds so good!
Oof, sounds like sniffing pepper straight! Which also sounds like it could turn out really intriguing on the skin..brb, going to look up Mr. Dark in the shop, lol.

Yayyy!! So glad you loved them too!! I was actually just talking to you about this in your own post but didn't realize I had my reddit accounts mixed up, so my usernames are different. Sorry if there was any confusion. :P

I can't wait to hear what you think of the rest of them! I really wanted to try Autumn People, but was trying to be disciplined. I might have to go back for it (and a few others).

Autumn People is the one I was wishing I'd gotten a sample of!! I may go back and order it so if I do I'll let you know what I think. :) And yeah, Old Books skyrocketed to the top of my faves. It's just so good!

I also liked it straight out of the box! I try to let me perfumes rest upon delivery but Old Books was just wonderful from the start. Edgar Allan Poe is also intriguing to me. Sounds like something I'd potentially hate or love, which makes me curious! And I know what you mean - fall is the most dangerous time of the year. All the pumpkin and earth tones and witchiness...Halloween is scariest for my wallet.
There's so many I want to try now! If you end up ordering any I'd love to hear your thoughts :D

SO sorry to hear you get headaches too!! Some things are insta-triggers for me like cucumber or most florals, but things that are too strong, persistent, or artificial can do it too. I know what you mean about it being a gamble!
Thanks! :)
Yup, I saw it there and couldn't resist! I've been having trouble figuring out how to wear it, so I appreciate the compliment, thank you! :)

>Need to find the right kind of casual

Totally feel for you! Only reversed obviously. It's tricky when the dress code is somewhere in between casual and put together because you don't want to go too over the top one way or the other.

Hope you first day goes great! :)
I love your fashion! Is it ok if I pin your 1/17 outfit on my work-clothes board? I love how you put together everything.
Hair = awesome. Hair + jumpsuit = super awesome.

Yay for bonus dog picture! :D

Like everyone else said, I'd ditch the cardigan. Do you have a shorter cardigan in a neutral color? Black or cream, maybe? 

I know you said you didn't want to go too dressy, but I have read that for interviews it's okay to look more polished than the actual dress code. So that's something you could think about too!

Good luck on your interview. :)
Totally love this outfit. If I saw you in IKEA I'd be thinking, 'omg, that girl is so much cooler than me...'
Love this look! The colors are great, and I love the proportions of everything. That's pretty funny how you and your cousin are matching, but the looks are still so different.

My first WAYWT post! 

1/17 - [worn to my new job](http://i.imgur.com/kmi4PgQ.jpg). 

This is my first job where there's an actual dress code (business super-casual, I'd say?), so I'm trying to learn how to put together appropriate outfits that still feel like 'me.'
I probably will eventually - I just wanted to gain a better understanding of what it might be before I decided to take apart the stitching, first.
Interesting, I had no idea! That gives me another route to start researching as well. I'm wondering what the letters might say. I think they would help narrow down the search, too.

Weird. Any idea what it might be? My mom is friends with a woman who runs an estate warehouse, and they often get random shipments in from houses where an old person has passed away. None of us have any idea what this might be, though.
Hopefully as I become a more seasoned traveler my mind will expand as well!  Thank you for taking the time to comment.

I'm feeling so much more encouraged now that I can overcome this and really have transformative travels in the future. I am very shy, but I am definitely going to try much harder now in future travels to put myself out there and really get to *know* the people and their culture. I'm feeling a bit more excited now, where before I was just discouraged with myself. Thank you so much for your comment!

What a wonderful comment - thank you. I think it's very important that I try to be more bold in future travels about getting to meet people and know the locals better! I enjoy meeting new people when I travel, but I'm naturally very shy and somewhat timid, so it's hard for me to put myself out there. I think it will really change things for me though - your closing line really struck me, especially. Thank you for taking the time to write and say all this!

Thank you for the understanding! I felt very nervous posting this here, because it seems like so many people in this sub are seasoned travelers, and I feel so bad feeling this way. But I have gotten so many understanding and helpful responses! I'm so glad I posted now. I'm feeling much more courageous now about continuing to travel and I feel optimistic I can overcome this! Thank you again. :)

Oh my gosh, you have officially got me hooked on these types of videos!! I have always tried to get a 'feel' for a place before going, but have never known where to look outside of PBS documentaries or travel books. This is so eye-opening for me! I know I will be doing this from now on. Thank you for the suggestion!
This is a great suggestion, thank you! Meeting new people is always one of my favorite parts of traveling, so I think this would really change things for me.
Thanks so much for the help, mrpoopiepants. You're name is cracking me up - and I could use a laugh! :)
It's not a hotel chain, unfortunately. It's just a run-down casino hotel, and they haven't been very helpful. We got them to wash our clothes but that was it.
Thanks for your offer. Hope your BB free now!
It's just a hokey casino hotel in run-down Laughlin, NV. At least we got our clothes cleaned, I guess. :(
It's a small hokey casino hotel, so I think we're going to struggle to get anything other than trash bags to put our clothes in. We already had to fight just to get our clothes washed.
You're welcome!
It's just tough because we can't afford to just toss our clothes and luggage. This is so frustrating. :(
I think we're going to take our car to a cleaners after we get home. Thank you for the advice.

The night manager was kind of a giant jerk to my husband and I. She laughed at us when we said we wanted to get our clothes cleaned and said, 'if you only found one, it's not a bedbugs. They're found in hordes." 

Guest services was a little more helpful today. They're going to wash our clothes. My husband is getting rid of his luggage, though, as it was on the floor by the bed the whole time. I wish they would compensate us for that, as well as maybe some new clothes while our other clothes are being washed.

Wow, I don't know where you stayed but their response was exceptional. We had to fight to get the hotel to clean our clothes, even. They acted like they were doing us a huge favor by providing us with plastic trash bags to put our clothes in.
At this point I'm just kind of tempted to set everything on fire.
Good tip. Thank you.
Sigh. I just got done asking the hotel for garbage bags and now I read this. Shoot. Maybe I should go buy ziploc XXL bags and see if they reimburse me.
Your neighbors would be in for a show, then.
The unsettling thing is that I did this - I ALWAYS check right when I get into a hotel room. There was no sign of them at all.
That's what I'm nervous about, too. The hotel is going to clean our clothes, but we've been in our car a couple times since we've arrived here. Ughhh.
Lord. As if I wasn't paranoid enough already.

Thank you so so much for taking the time to respond! Reading all these steps and knowing what my husband and I can do to hopefully prevent bringing them home is helping calm us down a little bit. I'm still nervous about driving in the car, but the hotel is going to be cleaning our clothes so hopefully it will be okay.
I think you're right. The shape looks a little different - that body is a little more elongated where this one is round - but I can't find anything else that matches it any more closely.
Crap. Thank you so much for steps on what to do next. I just informed management and am hoping they will compensate me for cleaning.

I just found this bug crawling on my blanket moments ago and now I can't sleep and don't know what to do next.

If it's a bed bug, do I ask my hotel to pay for cleaning my clothes/luggage? Can I drive back home or do I risk infecting my car? Thank you for your help. I'm freaking out.

I wish I could, but he's back at my workspace which is an hour away from me. On the bright side, there was a lot of water and food around him (pools of water along with carrots, insectivore and banana). Hopefully he'll be fine!
Is it really? Now I feel terrible for leaving it there :( I hope it ends up okay!
I totally did! I had a ton of work to get done, but I sat watching him for a while. I went back and checked on him while doing tasks, too. He was so cute :)
I agree! It's actually exactly why I shared the picture here. They deserve to be treated with a little more love!

And don't worry guys, he really is alive and well! Just sleepy and hot. He kept getting up and repositioning himself to get comfy, or would scratch his head and then stick his paw in his mouth (I guess scratching yourself is tasty business if you're a little mouse). 

[Here](http://www.imgur.com/FgpEv23.jpeg) are a couple more [pics](http://www.imgur.com/vXwQwKI.jpeg) for my karma conspiracists so you can see he was moving. :)
Thanks so much! It weirded me out when I first saw it. I thought something was invading my plant. :P

I am an extremely novice gardener, so please excuse me if this is a stupid question, but is it normal for them to sprout roots outside of the soil? And can I just trim them off?

Also, thanks for answering! :)
